messages:
sam-support: hi team — multiple support tickets (TICKET-4821, TICKET-4823). per-model throughput graphs in Console are showing 0 rps since ~05:12 UTC, customers think their traffic is failing.
jess-prod: seeing same in product slack, several customers escalated and pinged sales. backend traffic overall looks normal.
kai-eng-platform: is this only per-model charts or is global throughput impacted? can you paste the Console/PromQL query we use?
sam-support: Console query: `sum(rate(redwood_model_requests_total[1m])) by (model_id)` — returns zeros for every model.
lee-support: alert: `console:per_model_throughput_zero` fired at 2025-03-14T05:20Z :eyes:
incident-bot: New incident created: INC-2025-0314-1 — Per-model throughput metrics missing from console
maria-eng-ml: i queried Prometheus directly. metric `redwood_model_requests_total` exists but labels are different: `model_ref` and `model_version` — there is no `model_id` label anymore. e.g. `{model_ref=\"rw-7b-v1\", model_version=\"2025-03-13\"}`
kai-eng-platform: that suggests a label rename in the runtime's telemetry exporter. any runtime/telemetry deploys around 04:50–05:10?
jess-prod: we rolled runtime from 3.2.1 → 3.3.0 at 04:58 UTC. release notes mentioned a telemetry refactor (PR #4921).
sam-support: some customers also reported transient 429s earlier but those appear unrelated; main problem is visibility.
maria-eng-ml: quick repro PromQL to show the mismatch:
```
# dashboard (old) — returns 0
sum(rate(redwood_model_requests_total[1m])) by (model_id)
# existing metric samples
redwood_model_requests_total{model_ref=\"rw-7b-v1\", model_version=\"2025-03-13\"} 42
```
kai-eng-platform: ok. short-term mitigation: update Console queries to use the new label or synthesize `model_id` from `model_ref`. we can use `label_replace` to create a `model_id` alias in the query: 
```
label_replace(sum(rate(redwood_model_requests_total[1m])) by (model_ref), "model_id", "$1", "model_ref", "(.*)")
```
this will let dashboards restore per-model breakdown without touching the runtime.
lee-support: can we push that change quickly? customers are opening billing disputes because their charts show 0.
jess-prod: patching Console queries now — doing a canary rollout to internal orgs first.
kai-eng-platform: long-term we should make telemetry backward-compatible. option A: restore `model_id` label in runtime (preferred). option B: add a scrape relabel in metrics pipeline to translate `model_ref` → `model_id`.
maria-eng-ml: i'll own the runtime patch to reintroduce `model_id` as an alias (adds both labels). targeting 3.3.1 by EOD.
incident-bot: Console query patch rolled to canary at 05:44Z
jess-prod: canary looks good — internal org shows per-model rates again.
lee-support: internal customers and EU org reporting graphs fixed. closing tickets as 'monitoring' with notes.
kai-eng-platform: plan agreed: 1) keep Console query label_replace as a guard for 14 days, 2) ship runtime 3.3.1 which adds back `model_id` label, 3) add e2e test to prevent future label renames, 4) update release notes and changelog warnings.
maria-eng-ml: PR opened: #4980 — runtime adds `model_id` (alias to `model_ref`) and a unit test. requesting quick review.
sam-support: finance asked if there's billing impact — clarify: no requests were dropped, only visibility; customers saw zeros and filed disputes. support will send templated explanation and mark high priority.
jess-prod: agreed. also adding a small dashboard test in CI that validates `sum by (model_id)` returns nonzero for synthetic traffic.
kai-eng-platform: once 3.3.1 is deployed and dashboards stable for 2 hours we'll close the incident.
maria-eng-ml: deploying 3.3.1 to staging now, will post rollout timeline.
lee-support: thanks — i'll update all open tickets and customers with the temporary workaround and ETA.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation in place (console query fallback), workaround documented, runtime patch in progress.
jess-prod: great work team :tada:
sam-support: thanks all — keep updates in this thread for the audit trail.
